pages.title: SG-2026-031: SynthGate VPN 7.3.x gateways reject new passwords until the credential cache expires
pages.content: Affected: SynthGate VPN gateway firmware 7.3.0 to 7.3.9. After a directory password change, the gateway can keep validating against a cached credential for up to 60 minutes and clients report 'invalid credentials' or error 809. Fixed in firmware 7.4.2. Workaround: clear the gateway credential cache or route users to a gateway that has already synchronised.

pages.title: SynthGate VPN client 7.4.1 release notes
pages.content: Client 7.4.1 changes the keep-alive interval to 600 seconds. Some networks with aggressive idle timeouts drop the tunnel every 10 to 15 minutes; set keep-alive to 120 seconds in the client profile. Client 7.4.1 does not change credential handling.

pages.title: SynthGate cloud licence service: no current incidents
pages.content: All SynthGate cloud services are operational. On-premises gateways are not covered by this status page.

pages.title: SynthAir access points: radio resets every few minutes on firmware 9.1.0
pages.content: SynthAir access points on firmware 9.1.0 can reset their 5 GHz radio every 3 to 8 minutes when band steering is enabled. Clients drop and reconnect. Fixed in 9.1.2. Workaround: disable band steering on the controller.

pages.title: SynthLedger ERP error PAY-17: payment batch locked
pages.content: PAY-17 means the payment batch is locked by another session or a failed previous run. Release the lock from the batch monitor before re-running. Running the batch twice can create duplicate payments.

pages.title: SynthStor controller firmware 5.2: latency spikes during background scrubbing
pages.content: Controllers on firmware 5.1.x show intermittent latency spikes while background scrubbing runs. Upgrade to 5.2.3. The upgrade performs a controller failover; plan a maintenance window.

pages.title: Payroll-themed phishing wave targets European employers
pages.content: A phishing campaign asks employees to 'confirm payroll details' on look-alike portals and harvests passwords and MFA codes. Reset the passwords of anyone who entered credentials and revoke their active sessions.

pages.title: Forum: error 809 after the October update?
pages.content: Several users report error 809 after upgrading to client 7.4.1. Replies suggest it is the gateway credential cache issue (SG-2026-031), not the client. Unverified community content.
